items.title_es: Ethereum Gets Another Privacy Boost as Aztec Brings Back zk.money

items.title: Cboe's New S&P Deal Opens the Door to Tokenized Options
items.summary: The renewed agreement preserves Cboe's exclusive rights to S&P 500 index options through 2051 while opening the door to pairing the flagship benchmark with blockchain infrastructure.
items.title_es: Cboe's New S&P Deal Opens the Door to Tokenized Options

items.title: Bitwise Launches First US Spot Near ETF After Token Nearly Triples Since August
items.summary: Bitwise's NRR began trading on NYSE Arca Tuesday, giving brokerage accounts NEAR exposure and staking rewards as the AI-focused token soars.
items.title_es: Bitwise Launches First US Spot Near ETF After Token Nearly Triples Since August

items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin correction could be near as traders’ unrealized profit hits 21-month high
items.summary: Bitcoin could face a near-term correction as short-term traders' onchain unrealized profit margin has reached its highest level in 21 months, according to CryptoQuant.
items.title_es: CryptoQuant says bitcoin correction could be near as traders’ unrealized profit hits 21-month high

items.title: Comer presses Crypto.com, Hyperliquid and PredictIt on identity checks and suspicious trades
items.summary: Comer’s expanded probe seeks records on government insiders, employee trades and suspicious activity referrals.
items.title_es: Comer presses Crypto.com, Hyperliquid and PredictIt on identity checks and suspicious trades
